items.quote: Wir bitten Sie, den Rückstand bis 7. Dezember 2026 zu überweisen.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for payment: 'bis 7. Dezember 2026'. This is a private landlord's payment request (not a statutory authority deadline), so no deemed-delivery or §193 BGB shift rules apply automatically; the date is simply the one printed. The sum owed is the total of the stated open items: EUR 340.00 (Restbetrag Miete November 2026) + EUR 186.42 (Betriebskostennachzahlung 2025) = EUR 526.42. Due date is therefore 2026-12-07 as written.
